ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High (approx. 85-90% high-intensity white/light-grey pixels vs 10-15% low-intensity black/dark-grey pixels).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Continuous dark-intensity perimeter band along the trailing edge. A large, complex, vertically-oriented dark pigmentation cluster is centered below the median notch. Multiple sparse, low-diameter dark spots (focal points) are distributed across the right lobe surface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an approximate internal angle of 75 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Low-amplitude, high-frequency serrations along the primary trailing edge; amplitude increases significantly at the terminal tip of the right lobe where an irregular indentation is visible.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve extending from the notch to the distal tips, with a slight distal tapering on both lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Concentrated dark circular clusters localized within the central vertical pigmentation area; distinct yellowish-brown cluster at the extreme distal tip of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent yellowish-orange/brownish discoloration and irregular surface accumulation at the terminal end of the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: The central dark pigmentation exhibits a unique asymmetric dendritic pattern extending from the peduncle attachment point towards the median notch.
